name: Vincent van Gogh
bio: Dutch Post-Impressionist painter who became one of the most famous figures in Western art history. Created around 2,100 artworks characterized by dramatic impasto brushwork and expressive color.
bioPl: Holenderski malarz postimpresjonistyczny, uznawany za jedną z najważniejszych postaci w historii sztuki. Stworzył około 2100 dzieł wyróżniających się ekspresją i grubą fakturą (impasto).

catalog.title: The Starry Night
catalog.location: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), New York
catalog.locationPl: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), Nowy Jork
catalog.description: Depicts the view from Van Gogh's asylum room window at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence with swirling night skies.

catalog.title: Sunflowers series
catalog.location: National Gallery, London / Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam
catalog.locationPl: National Gallery, Londyn / Muzeum Van Gogha, Amsterdam
catalog.description: Famous series of still life paintings featuring vibrant yellow sunflowers created in Arles.

catalog.title: The Potato Eaters
catalog.description: Early Dutch period masterpiece depicting peasants sharing a modest meal under oil lamps.
